cues: The coronary arteries feed the heart muscle itself; block them, and that is a heart attack.
And the hepatic portal vein carries blood from the gut to the liver before it reaches the rest of the body.
text: Two special routes. The coronary arteries feed the heart muscle itself; block them, and that is a heart attack. And the hepatic portal vein carries blood from the gut to the liver before it reaches the rest of the body.
